name: Star Prince
source:
Dress up the Star Prince and help him find love! 

Prince Aurelian of the star, Minerva, has received an invitation to a royal ball on Mars! The only problem? His crush is there...and last time they saw each other? He was ignored! Help him catch the eye of the Prince of Mars with a truly intergalactic outfit!

[From [url=https://paperdollprince.itch.io/starprince]itch.io[/url]]
